title: Add Stripe Premium Subscription

requirements.text: Add a Premium Subscription tier to the backend: define a subscription status type (free/premium), store per-user subscription state, and expose functions to get and set a user's subscription status.

quotes: jo option pahle samjne main aur implement karne main asan ho add karo

acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores subscription status (free or premium) per user principal
A query function returns the caller's current subscription status
An update function allows setting a user's subscription to premium

requirements.text: Integrate Stripe Checkout on the frontend so authenticated users can purchase a Premium subscription. Add a checkout flow on the Upgrade page that initiates a Stripe payment session. On successful payment confirmation, call the backend to mark the user as premium.
acceptanceCriteria: The Upgrade page shows a 'Go Premium' button for free-tier users
Clicking the button initiates a Stripe Checkout session
After successful payment, the user's subscription status is updated to premium in the backend
The Upgrade page reflects the updated premium status after payment

requirements.text: Replace the hardcoded free-tier return in useGetUserSubscriptionStatus.ts with a real backend call that fetches the authenticated user's subscription status.
acceptanceCriteria: useGetUserSubscriptionStatus fetches subscription status from the backend actor
The UpgradePrompt component correctly hides for premium users based on real backend data
The Settings page correctly shows the user's real subscription tier

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths
Keep all Motoko logic in backend/main.mo
Only implement Stripe payment — no other payment providers
nonGoals: Ad system or ad revenue sharing
